notes.title: Puzzzle Roadmap
notes.notes:
Okay let's begin. For anyone wondering why yet another roadmap is being released, please check out the community post before this one which explained where I have been all this time.

First of all, Puzzzle is being, sort of, reborn. We are currently at [b]Version 0.1[/b]. The game will go through many iterations and phases before we can get to Version 1.0.

[h1]Phase One:[/h1]
[h3]August --- December[/h3]

 | | | Bug Fixes
 | | | New SFX
 | | | New Background Music
 | | | New UI
 | | | Massive gameplay overhaul - more "puzzle-like elements"
 | | | 100 new levels
 | | | "Secret Levels"
 | | | Menu overhaul - Main Menu, Settings Menu, Pause Menu, Updated credits
 | | | Animation overhaul
 | | | New trailer
 | | | Resolution bug fixes
 | | | Removal of facemask :(

End Result: [b]Version 0.4[/b]

[h1]Phase Two:[/h1]
[h3]January (2022) --- May[/h3]

 | | | Introduction of Secret Saturday
 | | | 200 more levels
 | | | Multiple background music tracks
 | | | More "Secret Levels"
 | | | Performance fixes
 | | | Epic Games Store
 | | | DLC??????
 | | | Plus a lot of epic stuff...

End Result: [b]Version 0.8[/b]

[h1]Phase Three?[/h1]

notes.title: What happened?
notes.notes:
My god.

I have been literally everywhere recently. Okay, so despite my timeline, secret Saturday, and Puzzzle's state in general, I have made barely any progress. Here's why.

I moved to a different city. And a different house. In turn, I just got my PC setup yesterday, and I didn't have much time before I left to work on Puzzzle, as I'm studying and have been very busy.

I am incredibly sorry for this and I should be back on track now and I will release the final timeline (I promise) very soon.

So sorry,

-Stephen Walton, "dev"

notes.title: Secret Saturday?
notes.notes:
Alright, I know the name sounds a little qwerky, but we can change that later...

I have this idea, which is based of of something that happened with the game Minecraft when it was in its   early stages of development. What happened was Notch (the developer) would include brand new items and mechanics into the game every Friday - it was called: "Secret Friday". What I'm going to do is I'm gonna [strike]steal[/strike] borrow Notch's idea and implement new game mechanics and stuff every Saturday starting from March 13th. Well actually I'm only going to do it if I receive support from the community (you guys) saying I should, so if you read this, reply to it and tell me if it's a good idea or not. Or if you're shy, you can either rate this post up or down. 

You have a deadline - 13th of March. It's your choice.

-Thanks, Stephen Walton, "dev"

notes.title: New Update Plan
notes.notes:
Oof, it's been a while. This is the brand-spanking new update plan to track Puzzzle's development over eternity. Enjoy what I've cooked up!

[h2]Indev:[/h2]                                                                                               
[h3]Now - April 16th[/h3]

This stage will be divided into three parts:

[b]DVTStage[/b] // Now - March 10th 
[b]HDVStage[/b] // May 10th - March 31st
[b]FDVStage[/b] // March 31st - April 16th

"DVTStage" or Development Tracking Stage is essentially housekeeping for the game, like working on patches, listening to user feedback, meeting small deadlines and making sure the game is ready for the "HDVStage", or Heavy Development Stage. This stage is where I fix larger bugs, add more levels, add a heavier emphasis to actual puzzles and add what you've all been waiting for... level select (woohoo!). "FDVStage" or Final Development Stage is where I polish what's been done in the last stage, and get the game ready for...

[h2]Outdev:[/h2]
[h3]April 22nd - June 30th[/h3]

This stage will be divided into two parts:

[b]DVTStage[/b] // April 20th - April 30th
[b]HDVStage[/b] // April 30th - June 30th

These stages are just like before, but in this HDVStage, there'll be even more fun stuff!

[h2]Postdev[/h2]
[h3]July 12th - Until I make a new game[/h3]

This is where I'll continually update, patch, and apply maintenance to the game after the major updates are done. You'll see a max of two more major updates here, then it'll just be small patches (so sad).

This entire process will be done on my youtube channel, and I mean every single thing, from the odd patch to the big updates. Check it out to stay updated. I'll think about making a twitter, but I don't know yet. 

-Thanks, Stephen Walton, "dev"

notes.title: Puzzzle Update Plan
notes.notes:
Here is the [b]update plan[/b] for [b]Puzzzle[/b]. It will take place over the next 2 or 3 months.

Version 1.1 - Minor / Major fixes in terms of bugs, performance, etc.

Version 1.2 - New minor features added to the game and improved UI. (E.g. Level selection).

Version 1.3 - Level redesign. All levels will be tweaked in some way to improve them, and more levels will 
                     be added in general. (E.g. Obstacles moved, wall-height changed, etc).

Version 1.4 - New obstacles added. Maybe 2 or 3 new obstacles will join the party.

Version 1.5 - Final update (for now), at least 200 levels in the game, almost all bugs fixed, new enemies, 
                     new levels, new helper objects, new UI, better movement mechanics, all "secret levels" 
                     implemented + much more!

Again, these changes will not be spontaneous but will happen over the course of 2 or 3 months of work. I may or may not document the process on my Youtube Channel (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCkzo_oahtIoaIxzyiqQjTog/featured?view_as=subscriber), I will decide. I will release a notification on Steam after each update so you can see the progress I'm making. I will probably also add an update progress bar in the actual game so you can track it there too. 

-Thanks, Stephen Walton, "dev"
